lerpAmount.title: Lerp Amount [0..1]
lerpAmount.description: The amount to lerp the camera towards its desired position every frame based on a 60fps frame rate. Lerping is frame rate independent though and will be correct for other frame rates.

cameraEntity.description: The camera entity to use for taking the screenshot with. Whatever, this camera renders will be in the screen capture.

drawShapes.title: Draw Shapes
drawShapes.description: Draw representations of physics collision shapes

castShadows.title: Cast Shadows
castShadows.description: Cast shadows from physics collision shapes

relativeTo.title: Relative To
relativeTo.description: The entity that drives the parallax effect.

parallaxFactor.title: Parallax Factor
parallaxFactor.description: How much the entity should move relative to the selected entity, by axis.

traumaMult.title: Trauma Multiplier
traumaMult.description: How strong the camera shake should be.

traumaMag.title: Trauma Magnitude
traumaMag.description: How far the camera should be shaken.

traumaRotMag.title: Trauma Rotation Magnitude
traumaRotMag.description: How far the camera should be rotated

traumaDecay.title: Trauma Decay
traumaDecay.description: How quickly the camera should stop shaking

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A unique name for the button to refer to it by in the API. Will give a warning in browser tools if the name is not unique.

vibration.title: Vibration duration (ms)
vibration.description: If the device supports vibration with 'Navigator.vibrate', it will vibrate for the duration set here on touch down.Set to 0 to disable.

platformEntity.title: Platform Entity
platformEntity.description: Вложенная энтити платформы, которую будем двигать

bottomY.title: Bottom Y
bottomY.description: Нижняя позиция платформы по оси Y

topY.title: Top Y
topY.description: Верхняя позиция платформы по оси Y
